definitions.gloss: analytical ability; analytical power; capacity for analysis
definitions.explanation: The ability to break down complex information, data, or problems into components and understand their relationships. Valued in academic, technical, and business contexts.

⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧{解析力|かいせきりょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不可欠|ふかけつ}→不可欠：07027_fukaketsu⟧だ。

notes:
A compound of ⟦{解析|かいせき}→解析：16075_kaiseki⟧ (analysis) and {力|りょく} (power/ability). Used in academic, scientific, and business contexts to describe the capacity for detailed analysis.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {解析力|かいせきりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have strong analytical ability
- {解析力|かいせきりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to improve analytical ability
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧{解析力|かいせきりょく}: data analysis capability

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{分析力|ぶんせきりょく}→分析力：08706_bunsekiryoku⟧: analytical ability — very similar; ⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧ is more common in everyday and business contexts, while ⟦{解析|かいせき}→解析：16075_kaiseki⟧ leans more technical/mathematical
- ⟦{洞察力|どうさつりょく}→洞察力：08523_dousatsuryoku⟧: insight, perceptiveness — the ability to see through to the essence of things
- ⟦{思考力|しこうりょく}→思考力：26879_shikouryoku⟧: thinking ability — broader cognitive ability, not limited to analysis
